title: NO KINGS RALLY - Celina, Ohio
description:
*In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.*

Join us on Flag Day for a “Day of Defiance”, as we stand united for democracy, justice, and the rights and freedoms that belong to all people- not the few. This protest is part of the “No Kings National Day of Action”, a growing grassroots response to threats against our democratic institutions and civil liberties. From attacks on free speech and dissent to abuses of power and disregard for the rule of law, we believe it’s time to push back- peacefully and powerfully. 
Together Mercer County LEAD and our partners are taking a stand. This is about more than any one leader or party, it’s about the kind of future we want to build.

This is not just a protest; it’s a movement, a call for action and change. Together, we will defend democracy and reject any attempts to undermine our freedoms. We are fighting for a future where the power belongs to the people, not corrupt billionaires or authoritarian figures.
Whether you’ve been fighting for justice for years or this is your first time standing up, your presence matters. Join us as we show that we won’t back down in the face of oppression.
Let’s rise together—for freedom, dignity, and a future that puts people first. 

No kings. No tyrants. Only the people. 

Learn more about the national movement at https://NoKings.org

On May 9, 2025, Rep. McIver joined clergy, elected officials, and community members to inspect Delaney Hall Detention Center — a facility with a history of human rights violations. Instead of transparency, they were met with force.  
Now she’s being charged — not for breaking the law, but for doing her job with courage.

By adding your name, your voice will be sent directly to:

- **U.S. Attorney Alina Habba**  
- **Attorney General Merrick Garland**  
- **Your Member of Congress**

This is a coordinated clergy and community sign-on letter — not just a petition.  
We are demanding real accountability, an end to retaliatory prosecution, and protection for Black women in leadership.

---

**📣 SIGN THE LETTER. ADD YOUR NAME. STAND WITH REP. MCIVER.**  
This is not the time to be silent.  
**This is the time to speak.**

title: Friday Rally - We Honor Our Veterans!
description:
Our democracy is under attack and we must all become courageous and brave.  Courage and bravery in today's conflicted political climate are, for many of us, in short supply.  So where do we look for strength when it seems all hope is vanishing?  We do have a place to look because so many Americans have already shown us what it looks like.  We need to turn to our veterans.

There are currently approximately 23 million American military
veterans.  Veterans are a solid representation of what it means to be an American; brave and proud of their country. Veterans devoted their family, life, realism and values to commit to a selfless act; serving their
country to support and defend the constitution and to promote the spread of democracy around the world.  

As we watch the US Constitution being flaunted and slowly eroded, we are reminded that the the framers of the Constitution recognized the tendency for human beings in power to abuse that power. They desired to establish a framework for government that takes into account human nature. Our veterans have taken an oath to uphold the US Constitution and have shown they were willing to give their lives for this commitment.

On Friday, June 6, 1944, we recognize the date as the time of the Normandy landings and associated airborne invasion during the WW II Operation Overlord invasion.  This is also known as D-Day.  Since then our brave soldiers have fought in the Korean War, the Vietnam War, the Gulf War, the Iraq War, the War in Afghanistan and others.

Today we proudly stand with you, veterans, as we look to you for our courage to stand against the current scourges being committed by our current administration.  

Today, we say, thank you.  Thank you for your devotion to this country and from you we gain our strength and courage to fight with you.  You are worthy.  You are not forgotten.  Please join us so we can personally thank you.

For those vets attending, please let us know you served as we have a small token of appreciation to let you know we will never forget.  For those who will attend but have not served, please find the vets and thank them. 
They deserve to be honored.  

Veterans, we thank you.
accessibility_notes: If you are ambulatory and able, please park in the lower lot so we can leave spaces for our less mobile friends.  Thank you.

title: Apoyando a los estudiantes y las familias inmigrantes en los entornos hostiles
description:
Acompaña a MomsRising y a The Advancement Project en la jornada informativa virtual: Apoyando a los estudiantes y las familias inmigrantes en los entornos escolares hostiles. 
En el polarizado clima político de hoy es más importante que nunca apoyar a los estudiantes inmigrantes en las escuelas públicas. Mientras los debates nacionales sobre inmigración se vuelven cada vez más acalorados, las escuelas, que deberían ser lugares seguros de aprendizaje y pertenencia, pueden sin querer ser un reflejo de la hostilidad, el temor y la discriminación que existe en la sociedad general. Sin nuestros esfuerzos colectivos intencionales para apoyar a los estudiantes y las familias inmigrantes, los prejuicios, las políticas y las prácticas perjudiciales y la falta de comprensión cultural pueden crear entornos en los que los estudiantes inmigrantes se sientan inseguros, invisibles y excluidos. Si no se controlan, estas condiciones hostiles no solo afectan el progreso académico de los estudiantes y su salud mental, también debilitan el tejido de las comunidades escolares.
Va a requerir que todos nosotros promovamos espacios inclusivos y afirmantes en nuestras escuelas y comunidades para contrarrestar la división, defender los principios de dignidad y oportunidad y asegurar que todos los estudiantes, sin importar dónde nacieron o su estatus, tengan la oportunidad de prosperar, liderar y contribuir con un futuro más sólido y equitativo para todos nosotros porque, para ser honestas, somos mejores juntos.
No podemos esperar a compartir este espacio contigo. Recuerda confirmar tu asistencia para participar y recibir noticias del evento incluyendo una guía de recursos para después del evento.

Join us for an engaging and impactful evening as local community organizations come together to host a forum focused on meaningful conversations and collaborative solutions for our schools.

What to Expect:

Panel Discussions – Hear from educators, community leaders, and advocates as they tackle key educational challenges and share ideas for building inclusive, equitable learning environments.

Interactive Q&A Sessions – Ask questions, share your voice, and take part in open dialogue about the future of education in our community.

Resource Sharing – Learn about local programs and initiatives that support students, families, and educators.

This is a valuable opportunity for parents, students, educators, and community members to come together, share experiences, and help shape a stronger educational future.

Don’t miss your chance to be part of the conversation and make a difference.
